deflection_zh: 你的感覺很重要，請馬上去找大人，現在就去！

5-6: 立刻陪在孩子身邊，不要留他一個人
說：你說出來很勇敢，我們一起想辦法
收好危險物品，例如刀、藥，保持安全
撥打 1925 安心專線（24 小時免付費）
或撥打 1995 生命線；危急請撥 119
7-8: 認真聽孩子說，不要急著否定或批評
問清楚：是否已經做了傷害自己的事
立刻告訴其他大人，並請專業的人協助
撥打 1925 安心專線（24 小時免付費）
撥打 1995 生命線；危急請撥 119

what_not_to_say: 不要說「不要這樣想」或「你只是想太多」
不要用威脅或指責的話
不要答應「我不會告訴別人」來保密
author: claude-haiku

en.deflection: Your feelings matter a lot. Please find a grown-up right now, okay?
triggers: i don't want to be alive
i don't want to be here

5-6: Stay right next to the child; don't leave them alone.
Say: you were brave to tell me, and we will work it out together.
Put away dangerous things, like knives and medicine, to keep them safe.
Call 1925 (24-hour toll-free helpline) or 1995 Lifeline; in an emergency, call 119.
7-8: Listen closely; don't rush to disagree or criticize.
Ask directly: have they already hurt themselves?
Tell another grown-up right away, and ask a professional to help.
Call 1925 (24-hour toll-free helpline) or 1995 Lifeline; in an emergency, call 119.

what_not_to_say: Don't say 'don't think like that' or 'you're overthinking it'.
Don't promise 'I won't tell anyone' to keep it secret.
